objective: Exceed annual ticket sales target and reduce CPA

planning_priorities.label: April and December draw tentpoles
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Maximise sales impact of April and December draw tentpole campaigns; plan activations early and focus on efficiency, attention and incremental sales.

planning_priorities.label: July/August football-themed context
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: No third FIFA World Cup tentpole; combine July and August budgets/prize plan with contextual football-themed TV creative and prize message.

planning_priorities.label: May new creative platform
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Support launch without fundamental media strategy change; maintain phasing towards deadline week and proven campaign tactics.

planning_priorities.label: Greater London growth opportunity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Demonstrate a combined strategic comms and media approach for incremental ticket sales in Greater London within the existing budget.

planning_priorities.label: Gameshow return
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Series two is planned as incremental budget above the media budget, with in-break BAU activation; consider improvements for 2026.

planning_priorities.label: Free ticket tactical use only
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: No broad free ticket promotion expected in 2026, but can be used tactically within high-profile partnerships such as Amazon or Google.

planning_priorities.label: Channel role clarity
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Provide clarity on OOH, audio, cinema, Sky Sports, Amazon, Display, Social and Search roles.

planning_priorities.label: Commercial opportunity strategy
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Review media savings/value beyond guarantees and consider Global, Channel 4 and direct ITV deal opportunities.

planning_priorities.label: 2026 testing framework
planning_priorities.brief_text_summary: Agree a testing framework based on growth opportunities in collaboration with media investment and insight teams.
